edges.subject: DNAJ family proteins
edges.quote: DNAJ family proteins have been linked to the occurrence and progression of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, spinocerebellar ataxia, Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease, spinal muscular atrophy, distal hereditary motor neuropathy, limb-girdle type muscular dystrophy, neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis and essential tremor in recent studies.

edges.subject: DNAJB1
edges.quote: DNAJB1 can degrade protein aggregates ataxin-3.

edges.subject: DNAJB2
edges.quote: DNAJB2 can inhibit the formation of huntington aggregates.

edges.subject: DNAJB6
